TAG.name: TAG
TAG.description:
The country defined by the tag or tag alias. Tag aliases are defined in /Hearts of Iron IV/common/country_tag_aliases, as a way to refer to a specific country (such as a side in a civil war) in addition to its actual tag. If the country with the exact tag doesn't exist, but a dynamic country originating from the specified tag does, the scope will refer to the dynamic country.

**Example:**
```paradox
`SOV = { country_event = my_event.1 }`
```

custom_override_tooltip.description: An [[#AND|AND]] trigger that has an overriden custom tooltip.
custom_override_tooltip.name: custom_override_tooltip
custom_override_tooltip.notes:
A positive tooltip can be set with tooltip and the tooltip to be used inside a [[#NOT|NOT]] can be set with not_tooltip. If no positive tooltip is provided and the root key is a localization key (not a formatter, see formatted localization), then a negative tooltip will be generated by appending _NOT to the root localization for the positive tooltip. Both tooltip and not_tooltip are bindable localizations.
[[Effects#custom_override_tooltip|Can also be used as effect.]]

Also supports [[Localisation#Bindable_localisation]].

if.name: if
if.notes:
Both nested (As in inside of if = { ... }) and unnested (As in the example) else and else_if exist. In case of overlap, unnested is preferred.
Can be useful for tooltip management: same as in effects, if the limit is unmet, nothing appears. If it is met, then the limit is hidden while the condition outside of the limit appears in the tooltip.
if = { limit = { trigger_1 = yes } trigger_2 = yes } is equivalent to OR = { NOT = { trigger_1 = yes } trigger_2 = yes }, but generates a different tooltip.

all_of.name: all_of
all_of.description:
Loops over an array of values and checks the enclosed triggers for each value. Returns true only if the triggers return true for EVERY value (logical AND across the array).

Each iteration stores the current value in a temp variable (default `v`) and the current index in another temp variable (default `i`), which can be referenced inside the triggers via `var:v` / `var:i` or the custom names given by `value`/`index`. Unlike `all_of_scopes`, this does NOT push a new scope — the scope is unchanged and only the variables differ per iteration.

Supported scopes: any — Supported targets: any.

array.description: The array of values to iterate over.

value.description: Temp variable name for the current value. Optional — default `v`.

index.description: Temp variable name for the current index. Optional — default `i`.

all_of_scopes.name: all_of_scopes
all_of_scopes.description:
Loops over an array of scopes and checks the enclosed triggers for each element. Returns true only if the triggers return true for EVERY element (logical AND across the array); false as soon as any element fails.

Each array element is pushed as the current scope (THIS) for its iteration, so inner triggers are evaluated in that element's scope. The element type is dynamic — it depends on the array's contents (e.g. `global.majors` → Country scopes, `BRA.cores_at_game_start` → State scopes) — so for static validation the body is treated as `any`/`Global` (no HOM004 inside). Use `all_of` when iterating over plain values rather than scopes.

Supported scopes: any — Supported targets: any.

array.description: The array to iterate over. For *_of_scopes this is an array of scopes (e.g. `global.majors`, `BRA.cores_at_game_start`, `ROOT.owned_states_at_game_start`); for *_of it is an array of plain values.

tooltip.description: Optional custom tooltip title loc key. When defined, the trigger's tooltip uses this loc; `loc_NOT` is used when the block is inside a `NOT`. If omitted, the engine generates a default tooltip from the enclosed triggers.

any_of.name: any_of
any_of.description:
Loops over an array of values and checks the enclosed triggers for each value. Returns true if the triggers return true for AT LEAST ONE value (logical OR across the array).

Each iteration stores the current value in a temp variable (default `value`) and the current index in another temp variable (default `index`). Use custom names via `value`/`index` to avoid collisions. Like `all_of`, the scope is NOT pushed — only variables are set per iteration.

Supported scopes: any — Supported targets: any.

array.description: The array of values to iterate over.

value.description: Temp variable name for the current value. Optional — default `value`.

index.description: Temp variable name for the current index. Optional — default `index`.

any_of_scopes.name: any_of_scopes
any_of_scopes.description:
Loops over an array of scopes and checks the enclosed triggers for each element. Returns true if the triggers return true for AT LEAST ONE element (logical OR across the array); false if none match.

Each array element is pushed as the current scope (THIS) for its iteration (dynamic — e.g. `global.majors` → Country, `BRA.cores_at_game_start` → State). Treated as `any`/`Global` for static validation since the element scope cannot be known statically. Use `any_of` when iterating over plain values.

Supported scopes: any — Supported targets: any.

array.description: The array to iterate over. For *_of_scopes this is an array of scopes (e.g. `global.majors`, `BRA.cores_at_game_start`, `ROOT.owned_states_at_game_start`); for *_of it is an array of plain values.

tooltip.description: Optional custom tooltip title loc key. When defined, the trigger's tooltip uses this loc; `loc_NOT` is used when the block is inside a `NOT`. If omitted, the engine generates a default tooltip from the enclosed triggers.

value.description: The temporary variable where the largest value will get stored.

index.description: The temporary variable where the index of the largest value will get stored.

is_in_array.name: is_in_array
is_in_array.description:
Checks whether a value is present in an array.

Supports two syntaxes: the structured form `is_in_array = { array = <array> value = <value> }` and the shorthand `is_in_array = { <array> = <value> }` (e.g. `is_in_array = { my_array = 42 }`). Returns true if `value` (which may be a literal, variable, or scope like `THIS`) is contained in `array`.

Supports `any` scope (usable anywhere) and no scope-target chaining. See also `any_of`/`all_of` (iterate triggers over every value) vs this trigger (single containment check).

array.description: The array to search. Can be a global array (`RAJ.raj_releasables`), a temp array, or a variable pointing to an array.

value.description: The value to look for. May be a literal (`42`), a temp variable (`var:v`), or a scope reference (`THIS`, `ROOT`, `PREV`). In shorthand form the array name itself is the key: `{ my_array = 42 }`.

is_in_state.name: is_in_state
is_in_state.description:
Checks whether a character is currently located in a specific state.

Valid for any character — generals (HQ location), admirals, scientists (facility / faction-program location), and operatives (mission location). Accepts a state ID (e.g. `64` for Brandenburg) or a dynamic state reference such as `ROOT.capital`, `PREV`, or a variable holding a state.

Supported scopes: CHARACTER — Supported targets: THIS, ROOT, PREV, FROM, CAPITAL.

state.description: Target state — a state ID (`64`), or a dynamic scope (`ROOT.capital`, `PREV`, `THIS`) that resolves to a state.

activate_advisor.name: activate_advisor
activate_advisor.description: Hires an advisor, placing them into their respective slot.

activate_decision.name: activate_decision
activate_decision.description:
Activates the specified decision for the current scope, ignoring triggers for the decision.

**Example:**
```paradox

```

activate_mission.description: Activates the specified mission for the current scope, ignoring any triggers for the decision.

add_breakthrough_progress.notes: The value can either be an absolute value or a script constant.

add_building_construction.name: add_building_construction
add_building_construction.description: Starts construction in the current state for the specified building.

type.description: The building to add.

level.description: Affect only provinces with buildings level below, at or above the specified level. Used in the province scope.

instant_build.description: Defines whether the buildings are instantly built.

province.description: Defines the exact province to add provincal buildings in. Can be used as a scope. Province scope

all_provinces.description: Affect all provinces within the state that meet each limit. Used in the province scope.

id.description: Affect the specified province ID. Used in the province scope, will apply for each province if inserted multiple times.

limit_to_coastal.description: Affect only coastal provinces within the selection. Used in the province scope.

limit_to_naval_base.description: Affect only provinces that have naval bases built. Used in the province scope.

limit_to_border.description: Affect only provinces that lie on a border between countries. Used in the province scope.

limit_to_border_country.description: Affect only provinces that border a specific other country. Used in the province scope.

limit_to_victory_point.description: Affect only provinces that meet the victory point amount prerequisite. If

limit_to_supply_node.description: Affect only provinces that have a supply node. Used in the province scope.

add_building_construction.notes:
For provincial buildings, '''must be done within the scope of the state that contains the province''' even if done on a specific province. '''If the controller country doesn't have an [[Country creation#Order of battle|order of battle assigned within the history file]], the buildings will not show up within the production menu''' until a recalculation of buildings, such as by changing consumer goods or reloading a savefile.
'''Can only be used within a state scope''', such as [[Scopes#random_owned_controlled_state|random_owned_controlled_state]]. The effect will do nothing when put into a country's scope.
For the list of building IDs present in the base game, see [[Building modding#Types]].

add_compliance.name: add_compliance
add_compliance.description: Adds compliance to the specified state.

add_contested_owner.name: add_contested_owner
add_contested_owner.description: Adds a contested owner to a state. The effect can be used either from a country or a state scope and accepts the other as parameter.

add_daily_mastery.name: add_daily_mastery
add_daily_mastery.description: Adds doctrine mastery daily for a certain duration.

amount.description: Amount of mastery to add per day.

days.description: Number of days to apply the daily mastery gain for.

folder.description: Optional - will filter by tracks in the specified folder.

grand_doctrine.description: Optional - will filter by tracks in folders with the specified grand doctrine.

sub_doctrine.description: Optional - will filter by tracks with the specified subdoctrine.

}

add_dynamic_modifier.name: add_dynamic_modifier

Adds a dynamic modifier to the specified scope (the default scope is ROOT).
It will be updated daily, unless forced to update early by force_update_dynamic_modifier effect.

Any modifiers that use variables within of the dynamic modifier will not show up in the tooltip of this effect, while those that are set to a static value will. Supports the state, country, character, and special project scopes.

add_equipment_bonus.name: add_equipment_bonus
add_equipment_bonus.description: Adds the specified equipment bonuses to the country. As description the given loc key or the name of given special project will be used. Same usage as in Ideas/National spirits.

requested_factories.description: The number of factories to assigned initially. Optional.

name.description: The name that'll be used for the equipment, such as with ships. Optional.

industrial_manufacturer.description: The military industrial organisation that's set as the equipment's designer. Equipment scope

type.description: The equipment to add. Either types and archetypes are accepted.

variant_name.description: The equipment variant to add. Mandatory if a variant needs to be created to produce the equipment, optional otherwise.

add_extra_state_shared_building_slots.name: add_extra_state_shared_building_slots
add_extra_state_shared_building_slots.description: Changes the number of shared building slots for the current state.
add_extra_state_shared_building_slots.notes:
Shared buildings slots being the ones used for multiple building types, such as military or civilian factories. This is in contrast to non-shared slots, such as those used by radio stations or air bases, which only can be changed globally with technologies.
'''Note:''' When using a variable and a [[Data_structures#Event targets|saved event target]], must be used as "saved_event.var_name" because "event_target:saved_event.var_name" will not work.

add_faction_influence_ratio.name: add_faction_influence_ratio
add_faction_influence_ratio.description: Adds influence to the country based on the given ratio of the faction’s total influence.

add_faction_influence_score.description: Adds influence to the country in the faction.

add_faction_initiative.name: add_faction_initiative
add_faction_initiative.description: Adds Faction Initiative points to the current country’s faction.

add_faction_power_projection.name: add_faction_power_projection
add_faction_power_projection.description: Adds power projection to the faction.

add_ideas.description: Adds the specified ideas to the current scope.
add_ideas.notes: Can be used as a scope to add multiple at once. If used to add ideas from categories where only one slot exists, it will replace any existing idea.

}

add_logistics.name: add_logistics
add_logistics.description: Adds logistics skill to the current unit leader.

add_mio_funds_gain_factor.name: add_mio_funds_gain_factor
add_mio_funds_gain_factor.description: Changes the base multiplier to MIO's funds.
add_mio_funds_gain_factor.notes: The multiplier is capped at 0 from below.

add_mio_industrial_manufacturer_assign_c.description: Changes the base political power cost of the MIO to assign production lines.
add_mio_industrial_manufacturer_assign_c.notes: The base amount is capped at 0 from below.

add_mio_policy_cooldown.description: Modifies the base length of a MIO policy cooldown.

add_mio_policy_cost.description: Modifies the base cost of a MIO policy.

add_project_progress_ratio.notes: The input value is a ratio of the total needed progress to complete the special project.

add_province_modifier.name: add_province_modifier
add_province_modifier.description: Adds a province modifier to the specified provinces in this state.

province.description: The province to apply the modifiers to.

provinces.description: Scope for selecting multiple provinces. The following arguments have to go inside it:

id.description: The ID of the province. Multiple can be specified.

all_provinces.description: Selects all provinces to which the limitations apply. The following arguments require it:

limit_to_coastal.description: Limits the selection of provinces to only coastal ones.

limit_to_border.description: Limits the selection of provinces to only ones bordering a different country.

limit_to_naval_base.description: Limits the selection of provinces to only ones that have a naval base.

limit_to_victory_point.description: Limits the selection of provinces to only ones that have a victory point, or a city, in them.

days.description: Will be temporary if specified, can be variable

add_province_modifier.notes: Province modifiers are defined in common/modifiers/*.txt

add_raid_history_entry.name: add_raid_history_entry
add_raid_history_entry.description: Add history entry to a raid.

add_random_trait.name: add_random_trait
add_random_trait.description: Adds a random trait from the list to the character.
add_random_trait.notes: Traits are found in common/unit_leader/*.txt files.

add_relation_modifier.name: add_relation_modifier
add_relation_modifier.description: The current scope gains the specified relation modifier '''towards the target scope'''.
add_relation_modifier.notes: Relation modifiers are found in common/modifiers/*.txt files, used to apply a [[Modifiers#Targeted modifiers|targeted modifier]] with a non-static target. To change the diplomatic opinion of a country, see [[#add_opinion_modifier|add_opinion_modifier]].

add_relation_rule_override.name: add_relation_rule_override
add_relation_rule_override.description: Toggles the special game rules for the current scope in diplomacy towards the specified country only, if the trigger is met.

usage_desc.description: A description used as the reason for the rule applying. Optional.

trigger.description: A scripted trigger deciding when the override should be active. Optional, defaults to always true.

add_relation_rule_override.notes: Currently can_access_market and can_send_volunteers are supported. In case of overlap, restricting actions is preferred (e.g. can_send_volunteers = no or can_not_declare_war = yes are preferred over the alternatives). In the scripted trigger, ROOT is the country with the override and FROM is the target.

add_research_slot.name: add_research_slot
add_research_slot.description: Adjusts the number of research slots the current scope has. Can remove slots with negatives.

add_resistance.name: add_resistance
add_resistance.description: Adds resistance to the specified state.

add_resistance_target.name: add_resistance_target
add_resistance_target.description: Increases resistance target in the specified state.

id.description: The ID of the target increase.

amount.description: The amount to increase the resistance target by.

occupied.description: Will only apply the increase if the the occupied country is the specified scope.

occupier.description: Will only apply the increase if the the occupier is the specified scope.

days.description: If set, the resistance target will only be increased for the specified amount of days.

tooltip.description: The tooltip to show in the resistance target tooltip.

examples:
add_resistance_target = {
 id = 123
 amount = 30
 occupied = ENG
 occupier = GER
 days = 365
 tooltip = my_localisation_key
}

add_resource.name: add_resource
add_resource.description: Adds the specified resource in the specified amount to the current state.

type.description: The resource to add.

amount.description: The amount to add.

add_resource.notes: [[#country_add_resource|Can also be used in country scope.]]

add_scientist_level.name: add_scientist_level
add_scientist_level.description: Add levels to a special project specialization for a scientist character in scope.

add_scientist_role.name: add_scientist_role
add_scientist_role.description: Adds the scientist role to a character.
add_scientist_role.notes:
The scientist role format is the same as in the character DB. Except the visible trigger, a scientist role created via effect cannot have triggers.
[[#add_scientist_role|Can also be used in country scope.]]

add_scientist_trait.name: add_scientist_trait
add_scientist_trait.description: Add a trait to a scientist character in scope.

add_scientist_xp.name: add_scientist_xp
add_scientist_xp.description: Add experience to a special project specialization for a scientist character in scope.

add_skill_level.name: add_skill_level
add_skill_level.description: Adds skill to the current unit leader.

add_stability.name: add_stability
add_stability.description: Adds to the current stability value for the current scope.

add_state_claim.name: add_state_claim
add_state_claim.description: Adds a claim for the current scope on the specified state.

add_state_core.name: add_state_core
add_state_core.description: Adds a core for the current scope to the specified state.

add_state_modifier.name: add_state_modifier
add_state_modifier.description: Adds a [[Modifiers|modifier]] to the current state.

add_state_resistance_compliance_modifier.name: add_state_resistance_compliance_modifier
add_state_resistance_compliance_modifier.description: Adds either a resistance or compliance modifier to a state. Can only use modifiers from the common/resistance_modifiers.txt/compliance_modifiers.txt that are marked as is_dynamic = yes

add_tech_bonus.name: add_tech_bonus
add_tech_bonus.description: Grants a research bonus to the current scope with the specified parameters.

bonus.description: The bonus to technology given, default 0.

uses.description: The amount of times the bonus can be used, default 1.

ahead_reduction.description: The cost reduction if ahead of time, default 0.

category.description: Which technology category the bonus applies to. Multiple can be defined.

technology.description: Which technology the bonus applies to. Multiple can be defined.

name.description: Tooltip shown in research tabs, optional.

add_tech_bonus.notes: Research bonus categories are defined in common/technology_tags/*.txt files, while technologies are defined in common/technologies/*.txt files.

add_temporary_buff_to_units.name: add_temporary_buff_to_units
add_temporary_buff_to_units.description: Adds the specified combat buff to the current unit leader.

days.description: The duration of the buff. Optional.

tooltip.description: The tooltip to display for the buff.

examples:
add_temporary_buff_to_units = {
 combat_offense = 0.25
 combat_breakthrough = 0.25
 org_damage_multiplier = -1.0
 str_damage_multiplier = 0.25
 war_support_reduction_on_damage = 0.2
 cannot_retreat_while_attacking = 1.0
 days = 7
 tooltip = ABILITY_FORCE_ATTACK_TOOLTIP
}

add_threat.name: add_threat
add_threat.description: Adjusts the level of World Tension.

add_timed_idea.name: add_timed_idea
add_timed_idea.description: Adds the specified ideas to the current scope for the specified number of days.

days.description: The number of days to add the idea for.

months.description: The number of months to add the idea for. A month is equal to 30 days.

years.description: The number of years to add the idea for. A year is equal to 365 days.

add_timed_idea.notes: Either one of days, months, or years is mandatory. The tooltip will use the exact same phrasing in years/months/days as used in the attributes.

add_timed_unit_leader_trait.name: add_timed_unit_leader_trait
add_timed_unit_leader_trait.description: Adds the specified trait to the current unit leader for the specified duration.

days.description: The duration of the trait.

add_timed_unit_leader_trait.notes: Traits are found in common/unit_leader/*.txt files.

add_to_array.name: add_to_array
add_to_array.description: Adds an element to the array either at the specified index, defaulting to the end otherwise.

value.description: The variable to add.

index.description: The index to place the variable on in the array. Optional, defaults to the end of the array.

add_to_faction.name: add_to_faction
add_to_faction.description: Adds the country to the faction of the current scope.

add_to_tech_sharing_group.name: add_to_tech_sharing_group
add_to_tech_sharing_group.description: Adds the current scope to the specified technology sharing group.
add_to_tech_sharing_group.notes: Technology sharing groups are found in Hearts of Iron IV\common\technology_sharing\*.txt

add_to_variable.name: add_to_variable
add_to_variable.description:
Increases a variable's value by the specified amount, creating it if not defined.

**Example:**
```paradox
add_to_variable = {
    var = my_variable
    value = 100
    tooltip = add_100_to_var_tt
}
```

```paradox
add_to_temp_variable = { temp_var = num_owned_states }
```

add_to_war.name: add_to_war
add_to_war.description: Forces the current scope to join the war of the specified ally against the specified enemy.

hostility_reason.description: Localization for the reason for joining. Optional.

add_trait.name: add_trait
add_trait.description: Adds the specified country leader trait to the character.

slot.description: Slot of the character. Necessary for advisors.

ideology.description: Ideology type of the character. Necessary for country leaders.

add_trait.notes: Ideology type refers to a sub-type of an ideology group assigned to characters, commonly referred to as sub-ideologies in community jargon. The character slot can be the character's name or id. Using name is recommended because 1.11 made id obsolete.

add_unit_bonus.name: add_unit_bonus
add_unit_bonus.description: Adds permanent subunit and subunit category bonuses for country.

add_unit_leader_trait.name: add_unit_leader_trait
add_unit_leader_trait.description: Adds the specified trait to the current unit leader.
add_unit_leader_trait.notes: Traits are found in common/unit_leader/*.txt files.

add_units_to_division_template.name: add_units_to_division_template
add_units_to_division_template.description: Adds the specified brigades to first available slots of specified columns to the template (if possible).

template_name.description: The template to change. Optional if used in division scope. regiments = { = } support = { = } The units to add to the template. Sub-units are defined in common/units/*.txt files.

add_units_to_division_template.notes: Columns go left-to-right starting with 0. Can also be used in division scope.

add_victory_points.name: add_victory_points
add_victory_points.description: Adds victory points to a province.
add_victory_points.notes:
Accepts negative values.
 * Empirically tested: works in Country scope, NOT in State scope. Takes explicit province and value parameters.

add_war_support.name: add_war_support
add_war_support.description: Adds to the current war support value for the current scope.
add_war_support.notes: War Support values are between 0 and 1.

air_experience.name: air_experience
air_experience.description: Adds the specified amount of air experience to the current scope.

annex_country.name: annex_country
annex_country.description: Annex the specified country for the current scope.

transfer_troops.description: Whether to transfer the troops of the annexed country.

annex_country.notes: Without transfering troops, the annexed country's divisions' equipment is lost.

army_experience.name: army_experience
army_experience.description: Adds the specified amount of army experience to the current scope.

become_exiled_in.name: become_exiled_in
become_exiled_in.notes: Must be fired from ROOT, the country that should be exiled, or a TAG specification must be used. This effect would not automatically force a country to capitulate.

break_embargo.name: break_embargo
break_embargo.notes: As of 1.14.7, this effect ignores country scoping and always applies to the ROOT, instead the [[#diplomatic_relation|diplomatic_relation]] effect can be used to break the embargoes of other countries.

build_railway.name: build_railway
build_railway.description: Adds a railway level between two provinces or along a predefined path.

build_only_on_allied.description: No by default, if yes and in a country scope, it will only build on allied territories for the country scoped.

fallback.description: Defaults to no, if yes each option will try to fallback to the next available one.

target_state.description: If using start state/target state, the game will pick the provinces with the best supply available. If using state province/target province, the game will link those two provinces.

cancel_border_war.name: cancel_border_war
cancel_border_war.description: Cancels an on-going border war without a winner.

dont_fire_events.description: Stops the events from start_border_war from firing.

cancel_resistance.name: cancel_resistance
cancel_resistance.description: Cancels resistance activity for the current state.

capture_operative.name: capture_operative
capture_operative.description: Makes the current operative be captured by a specific country.

captured_by.description: By which country to get captured.

ignore_death_chance.description: Whether to ignore the death chance on capture (no by default).

career_profile_step_missiolini.name: career_profile_step_missiolini
career_profile_step_missiolini.description: Step completed Mussolini missions by one for the career profile.

change_tag_from.name: change_tag_from
change_tag_from.description: Switches the player to the current scope from the target scope. Nothing happens if the target scope is controlled by AI.

abc.description: will make the player controlling XYZ play as ABC instead.

change_tag_from.notes: '''The country the player becomes needs to be the scope in which the command is used.''' For example, ABC = { change_tag_from = XYZ } will make the player controlling XYZ play as ABC instead.

character_list_tooltip.name: character_list_tooltip
character_list_tooltip.description: Displays a list of every character meeting the specified limitation and recruited by the current country.

limit.description: Triggers that must be fulfilled to show up in the list.

random_select_amount.description: Upper bound on the characters that may be shown.

clamp_variable.name: clamp_variable
clamp_variable.description:
Clamps the variable to ensure its value is between the two specified numbers, raising to the minimum if smaller or lowering to the maximum if larger.

**Example:**
```paradox
clamp_variable = {
    var = my_var
    min = 0
}
```

```paradox
clamp_temp_variable = {
    var = my_var
    min = 0
}
```

clear_array.name: clear_array
clear_array.description: Clears the array, removing every element inside.

clear_division_template_cap.name: clear_division_template_cap
clear_division_template_cap.description: Clears the cap on the template, allowing it to have an unlimited amount of divisions.

division_template.description: The name of the division template.

clear_global_event_target.name: clear_global_event_target
clear_global_event_target.description: Clears a specific global event target.

clear_variable.name: clear_variable
clear_variable.description:
Clears the value from the memory entirely.

**Example:**
```paradox
clear_variable = my_variable
```

clr_unit_leader_flag.name: clr_unit_leader_flag
clr_unit_leader_flag.description: Clears a defined unit leader flag.
clr_unit_leader_flag.notes: Deprecated. Use [[#clr_character_flag|clr_character_flag]] instead. No tooltip is shown.

complete_mio_trait.name: complete_mio_trait

show_modifiers.description: Whether the trait's modifiers should be shown in the tooltip. Defaults to true.

complete_mio_trait.notes: Automatically adds 1 size to the MIO. No checks are placed on the trait.

complete_national_focus.name: complete_national_focus
complete_national_focus.description: Completes the specified focus for the current scope.

use_side_message.description: Create popup notification in the bottom right that includes

complete_national_focus.notes: In 1.15 block version was added, 'originator_name' can be TAG, character, state, or any other localization key.

complete_prototype_reward_option.name: complete_prototype_reward_option
complete_prototype_reward_option.description: Complete a prototype reward option for the project in scope

prototyp_reward_option.description: If multiple choice use the given one, use default one if not set. Optional.

show_modifiers.description: Yes if the effects of the prototype reward should be shown (default no)

complete_prototype_reward_option.notes: The effect will respect the fire only once and allowed property of prototype rewards.

complete_special_project.name: complete_special_project
complete_special_project.description: Complete a special project for the country in scope. This effect will not take into account the current state of the project tree and will allow you to unlock a project even if the one before is not unlocked. Since the project is not completed within a facility, the facility state and scientist effects are NOT applied.

scientist.description: Optional, default to current scientists on the project.

state.description: Optional, default to current state of the project.

iteration_output.description: Optional, can be a single reward or reward = option.

complete_special_project.notes: project, scientist, state accepts variables and keywords.

construct_building_in_random_province.name: construct_building_in_random_province
construct_building_in_random_province.description: Set building level in a random province of state scope.

country_event.name: country_event
country_event.description: Fires the specified event for the current country.

days.description: Fires the event in the specified number of days. Optional.

hours.description: Fires the event in the specified number of hours. Optional.

random_hours.description: Adds a random number (between ''0'' and ''random_hours'', inclusive) of hours to the scheduled fire time. Optional.

random_days.description: Adds a random number (between ''0'' and ''random_days'', inclusive) of days to the scheduled fire time. Optional.

examples:
country_event = {
 id = my_event.1
 days = 10
 random_hours = 12
 random_days = 10
}

country_event = my_event.1
country_event.notes: Where triggers do not need to be repeatedly checked random can be a performance light alternative to mean_time_to_happen for scheduling events. Shortened variant exists if the event's ID is used instead of arguments.

country_lock_all_division_template.name: country_lock_all_division_template
country_lock_all_division_template.description: Locks all division templates for the current scope.
country_lock_all_division_template.notes: Used to prevent training, disbanding, and editing units.

create_colonial_division_template.name: create_colonial_division_template
create_colonial_division_template.description: Create a colonial division template for overlord/owner.

subject.description: Country tag for an overlords subject.

division_template.description: The regular effect to create a division template.

create_colonial_division_template.notes: In country scope of overlord, E.g. ROOT = ENG.

create_corps_commander.name: create_corps_commander
create_corps_commander.description: Creates a commander for the current scope with the specified attributes.

attack_skill.description: The attack skill of the leader.

defense_skill.description: The defense skill of the leader.

planning_skill.description: The planning skill of the leader.

logistics_skill.description: The logistics skill of the leader.

traits.description: The traits the leader spawns with.

legacy_id.description: The legacy ID used for the unit leader. Optional.

create_corps_commander.notes: Traits are found in common/unit_leader/*.txt. '''Deprecated''', recommended to use [[#add_corps_commander_role|add_corps_commander_role]] instead when possible. '''The created corps commander will not be able to have a portrait if assigned to be a minister via officer corps, causing errors.'''

create_country_leader.name: create_country_leader

picture.description: The graphical reference to the leader portrait.

expire.description: When the leader dies in history.

ideology.description: The sub-ideology of the country leader. Does not accept regular ideologies.

female.description: The gender of the leader. Traits scope

traits.description: The trait to add. Can add multiple.

create_country_leader.notes:
The portrait uses a spriteType, defined within interface/*.gfx.

Sub-ideologies are defined in common/ideologies.

Deprecated. Recommended to use [[#add_country_leader_role|add_country_leader_role]] instead when possible.

create_dynamic_country.name: create_dynamic_country
create_dynamic_country.description: Creates a new dynamic country, akin to ones used in civil wars.

original_tag.description: The original tag to be used by the country.

copy_tag.description: If specified, copies stuff from this tag rather than the original tag.

create_dynamic_country.notes:
The [[#reserve_dynamic_country|reserve_dynamic_country]] effect can be used if the dynamic country does not yet exist in order to ensure that it does not get overwritten by other creations of dynamic countries. If this is not done, the dynamic country will immediately stop existing if no states are transferred in the same scope.

Every state of the original country immediately gets set as a dynamic country's core: if that's unneeded, the cores would need to be removed after creation.

create_entity.name: create_entity

entity.description: The entity to spawn, defined within gfx/entities/*.asset files.

id.description: A number ID which can be referred to by other effects. Optional.

var.description: If provided, the id of the entity will be stored using this variable. Optional.

x.description: The X position of the entity.

y.description: The Y position of the entity.

z.description: The Z position of the entity.

province.description: The province the middle of which to use as the entity's position.

state.description: The state the middle of which to use as the entity's position.

rotation.description: The rotation of the entity in radians.

min_zoom.description: Minimum zoom level needed to be able to see the entity.

visible.description: The scripted trigger that must be met for a country for it to see the entity.

examples:
create_entity = {
 entity = entity_name
 id = 123
 var = var_name
 x = 42
 y = 21
 z = 3
 province = 123
 state = 42
 rotation = 1.2
 scale = 10.0
 min_zoom = 100.0
 visible = scripted_trigger_name
}
create_entity.notes: Uses the [[Map modding#Coordinate system|the same coordinate system that the map uses.]] A positive change in rotation results in counter-clockwise rotation, a full 360 degrees rotation is approximately 6.28 radians. For comparison, default minimum zoom level (closest to the map) is 50 units, while default maximum zoom level is 3000 units.

create_equipment_variant.name: create_equipment_variant
create_equipment_variant.description: Creates the specified equipment variant for the current scope.

type.description: The equipment type the variant is of.

parent_version.description: Ordering for multiple variants of the same equipment. 0 is the oldest, 1 is the second-oldest, etc. Optional, 0 by default.

show_position.description: Dynamic equipment version numbering. If disabled removes the suffix from the equipment name. Numbering linked to ''parent_version''. Optional, yes by default.

obsolete.description: Whether the equipment variant is flagged as obsolete within the GUI and for AI. Optional, no by default.

mark_older_equipment_obsolete.description: Marks all older (non-chassis) equipment variants as obsolete as long as the following matches: Archetype, niche, mission set (for planes). Optional, defaults to false.

name_group.description: The name group used for equipment. Stored in common/units/names_ships. Optional, can only be defined for ships.

role_icon_index.description: Index of the role icon that will be used, as an integer. If set to "auto", will pick automatically. If set to 0, will be unset. Optional, only can be defined for ships.

model.description: Model that will be used by the equipment on the world map. Optional.

icon.description: The icon that will be used by equipment. Stored as a spriteType within interface/*.gfx. Optional.

design_team.description: The military industrial organisation that should be set as the designer of the equipment. Optional.

allow_without_tech.description: If set, bypasses the requirement that the equipment that the variant is for must be unlocked through research. Optional, defaults to false. Upgrade scope

create_equipment_variant.notes:
Role icons for ships are defined in gfx/army_icons/army_icons.txt.

Upgrades are defined within common/units/equipment/upgrades/*.txt.

Equipment types, including module slots for them, are defined within common/units/equipment/*.txt.

Equipment modules are defined within common/units/equipment/modules/*.txt.

create_faction.name: create_faction
create_faction.description: Creates a faction with the specified name for the current scope. The current scope and any subjects automatically join the faction.

create_faction_from_template.name: create_faction_from_template
create_faction_from_template.description: Create a faction from a template allows for optional customization of name, icon and color.

color.description: The color of the faction in RGB format.

create_field_marshal.name: create_field_marshal
create_field_marshal.description: Creates a field marshal for the current scope with the specified attributes.

attack_skill.description: The attack skill of the leader.

defense_skill.description: The defense skill of the leader.

planning_skill.description: The planning skill of the leader.

logistics_skill.description: The logistics skill of the leader.

traits.description: The traits the leader spawns with.

legacy_id.description: The legacy ID used for the unit leader. Optional.

create_field_marshal.notes: Traits are found in common/unit_leader/*.txt. Deprecated, recommended to use [[#add_field_marshal_role|add_field_marshal_role]] instead when possible. '''The created field marshal will not be able to have a portrait if assigned to be a minister via officer corps, causing errors.'''

create_import.name: create_import
create_import.description: Creates an import for the current scope with the specified resource and from the specified exporter.

amount.description: The amount of resource to import.

create_intelligence_agency.name: create_intelligence_agency

name.description: The name of the intelligence agency. (Optional)

icon.description: The icon of the intelligence agency. (Optional)

create_intelligence_agency.notes: Both parameters are not required, thus you can call the effect with just create_intelligence_agency = yes. This will check if any specific intelligence agency cosmetics should be used for the nation, and if not it uses the default.

create_navy_leader.name: create_navy_leader
create_navy_leader.description: Traits are found in common/unit_leader/*.txt. Deprecated, recommended to use [[#add_naval_commander_role|add_naval_commander_role]] instead when possible. '''The created admiral will not be able to have a portrait if assigned to be a minister via officer corps, causing errors.'''

attack_skill.description: The attack skill of the leader.

defense_skill.description: The defense skill of the leader.

maneuvering_skill.description: The maneuvering skill of the leader.

coordination_skill.description: The coordination skill of the leader.

traits.description: The traits the leader spawns with.

legacy_id.description: The legacy ID used for the unit leader. Optional.

examples: Creates a naval leader for the current scope with the specified attributes.

create_operative_leader.name: create_operative_leader
create_operative_leader.description: Creates an operative for the current scope with the specified attributes.

bypass_recruitment.description: Whether the operative is directly added to the list of available operatives or needs to be recruited.

available_to_spy_master.description: Whether the operative can be recruited by the spy master. bypass_recruitment should be set to no.

portrait_tag_override.description: If selecting a random portrait, create one that is from the specified country rather than the current country.

gfx.description: The graphical reference of the picture of the leader, defined as a sprite within any interface/*.gfx file.

traits.description: The traits the leader spawns with.

gender.description: The gender of the operative. Defaults to random.

create_operative_leader.notes: Traits are found in common/unit_leader/*.txt. All arguments aside from bypass_recruitment are optional. '''Must use a spriteType for the portrait''', a direct link as in "gfx/leaders/TAG/filename.dds" will not work.

create_production_license.name: create_production_license
create_production_license.description: Grants the specified country a license to produce the specified equipment from the current scope.

new_prioritised.description: Whether new equipment is prioritised or not. Yes by default.

cost_factor.description: Modifies the production cost. Equipment scope

type.description: The equipment the country is licensed to produce. Must be an non-archetype equipment.

version.description: The version indicates which variant should be licensed. The default is 0, meaning the base variant.

create_purchase_contract.name: create_purchase_contract
create_purchase_contract.description: Creates a purchase contract with the specified parameters.

civilian_factories.description: The amount of civilian factories required by the contract.

equipment.description: The equipment that the contract is for. In particular, contains these attributes: :

type.description: The archetype of the equipment. :

amount.description: The amount of the specified equipment.

create_railway_gun.name: create_railway_gun

equipment.description: Equipment type used by the railway gun.

name.description: The name used by the railway gun. Optional.

location.description: Location where the railway gun is created. Assumes the capital by default.

create_ship.name: create_ship
create_ship.description: Create a ship from another country and assign it to the reserve fleet. If not set, it will be the scoped country.

type.description: The type of ship to create.

creator.description: The country that created this ship. Optional.

amount.description: The amount of ships to create. Optional, defaults to 1.

create_unit.name: create_unit
create_unit.description: Adds the specified division to the current state.

prioritize_location.description: If possible, this province within the state gets used. Optional.

allow_spawning_on_enemy_provs.description: Allows the units to be created on provinces owned by the division owner's enemy. Defaults to false.

count.description: The amount of units to create. Defaults to 1.

id.description: The ID to identify the unit. Only used in delete_unit.

country_score.description: A MTTH block deciding the province in the state where the division should spawn, evaluates in the scope of the controller. Defaults to prioritising owner's controlled provinces first and then owner's allies.

divisional_commander_xp.description: give the division commander experience on unit creation The following arguments go within

division_template.description: The template to be used by the division. :

start_experience_factor.description: Experience of the division, with 0 being none and 1 being full training. Defaults to 1. :

start_equipment_factor.description: Equipment stockpile of the division. Defaults to 1. :

start_manpower_factor.description: Manpower stockpile of the division. Defaults to 1. :

force_equipment_variants.description: Forces a certain type of equipment to be used. Multiple equipment types can be added by adding multiple = {} lines.

create_unit.notes:
The division string '''must be on one line'''. A linebreak in the middle of division = "..." will break the effect and result in no units being spawned.
'''Can only be used within a state scope''', such as [[Scopes#capital_scope|capital_scope]]. The effect will do nothing when put into a country's scope.
'''Equipment factor cannot be set to zero.''' If set to zero, it will be treated as a 1. Created equipment will be the latest available to the country.

create_wargoal.name: create_wargoal
create_wargoal.description: Grants the current scope a wargoal against the specified country.

type.description: The wargoal to generate.

generator.description: The states to supply the wargoal (i.e. take_state_focus).

expire.description: The amount of days that the wargoal will last before expiring. If unset or set to 0, will never expire.

create_wargoal.notes: [[War goal#War goal types|Wargoal types]] can be found in common/wargoals/*.txt

custom_effect_tooltip.name: custom_effect_tooltip
custom_effect_tooltip.description: Displays a localized key in the effect tooltip.

custom_override_tooltip.name: custom_override_tooltip
custom_override_tooltip.description: Executes the provided effects but with a custom tooltip surpressing all tooltips from all other effects inside this block.

not_tooltip.description: The localisation key to use for NOT block. Optional.

custom_override_tooltip.notes:
[[Triggers#custom_override_tooltip|Can also be used as trigger.]]
Also supports [[Localisation#Bindable_localisation]].

damage_building.name: damage_building
damage_building.description: Damages a building in a targeted state or province.

type.description: The building to damage.

tags.description: The buildings with these tags to damage.

repair_speed_modifier.description: Repair will be x% slower until building is fully repaired

damage.description: The amount of damage to inflict.

province.description: The province to target for provincal buildings.

damage_building.notes:
The health of buildings is determined by the '''value''' attribute in a building's definition. This is multiplied by their level to get their total health.
[[#damage_building|Can also be used in country scope.]]

damage_units.name: damage_units
damage_units.description: Damages units in the specified area.

region.description: Strategic region where to damage units.

limit.description: Will only delete units if the triggers within are met for the country that owns the units.

damage.description: The percentage of damage done to units.

org_damage.description: The percentage of damage done to units to organisation in particular.

str_damage.description: The percentage of damage done to units to strength in particular.

ratio.description: Will damage a ratio damage to total organisation/strength of unit if set.

template.description: If specified, requires the template name to match.

examples:
damage_units = {
 province = 42
 state = 5
 region = 5
 limit = { has_country_flag = TAG_test }
 damage = 0.5
 org_damage = 0.5
 str_damage = 0.5
 ratio = yes
 template = "template_name"
 army = no
 navy = yes
}

deactivate_advisor.name: deactivate_advisor
deactivate_advisor.description: Dismisses an advisor from their respective slot, leaving it empty.

deactivate_shine_on_focus.name: deactivate_shine_on_focus
deactivate_shine_on_focus.description: Deactivate the shine effect on the focus with the given id. The current focus cannot have it's shine effect removed.
deactivate_shine_on_focus.notes: Tooltips are only shown in debug mode.

declare_war_on.name: declare_war_on
declare_war_on.description: Makes the current scope declare war on the specified country with the specified wargoal.

type.description: The wargoal to declare with.

generator.description: The states to supply the wargoal (i.e. take_state_focus).

declare_war_on.notes: [[War goal#War goal types|Wargoal types]] can be found in common/wargoals/*.txt. See also [[#add_civil_war_target|add_civil_war_target]] in order to assign a war between different countries to be a civil war.

delete_unit.name: delete_unit
delete_unit.description: Deletes all units that meet the filters.

state.description: The id number of the state the unit must be in.

division_template.description: The template the units must use to be deleted.

id.description: The id given to the unit if created via the

disband.description: If true, will refund equipment and manpower.

delete_unit.notes: No tooltip is generated. delete_units can be used if deleting all units of a specific template.

delete_unit_template_and_units.name: delete_unit_template_and_units
delete_unit_template_and_units.description: Deletes the specified division template and all units using it for the current scope.

division_template.description: The name of the division template.

delete_units.name: delete_units
delete_units.description: Deletes all units with a certain template.

division_template.description: The template the units must use to be deleted.

disband.description: If true, will refund equipment and manpower.

delete_units.notes: Generates a tooltip, unlike delete_unit. Mandatory to specify a division_template.

demote_leader.name: demote_leader
demote_leader.description: Demotes the current unit leader to Commander (if Field Marshal).

destroy_entity.name: destroy_entity
destroy_entity.notes: IDs are set by the [[#create_entity|create_entity effect]].

destroy_ships.name: destroy_ships
destroy_ships.description: Destroys the specified type and amount of ships controlled by the current scope.

type.description: The type of ship to destroy.

diplomatic_relation.name: diplomatic_relation
diplomatic_relation.description: Used to define a diplomatic relation between the current scope and target scope country.

country.description: The target country to alter the relationship with ROOT.

active.description: Whether the relation is started or broken.

dismantle_faction.name: dismantle_faction
dismantle_faction.description: Dismantles the faction of the current scope.

divide_variable.name: divide_variable
divide_variable.description:
Divides a variable's value by the specified amount.

**Example:**
```paradox
divide_variable = {
    var = my_variable
    value = 100
    tooltip = divide_var_by_100_tt
}
```

```paradox
divide_temp_variable = { temp_var = num_owned_states }
```

division_template.name: division_template
division_template.description: Creates and adds the specified division template to the current scope.

division_names_group.description: The division names group that the template will use, deciding on the automatically-generated names of any new divisions built using that template. Optional, assigns one automatically if omitted. These are defined within common/units/names_divisions/*.txt files.

is_locked.description: Whether the division is locked to modification and deletion. Optional.

force_allow_recruiting.description: Whether the locked template can have units deployed using it without allowing editing. Optional, only has an effect in locked templates.

division_cap.description: The maximum amount of divisions that this template may have; requires the template to be locked. Optional.

priority.description: The priority the template receives in receiving supplies. Goes from 0 to 2. Optional, 1 by default.

template_counter.description: The icon used by the division as an integer. Optional, defaults to the icon of the most common sub-unit within. The icons are defined as sprites within any interface/*.gfx file (By default

override_model.description: Enforces the entity used by the units using this template to be the specified one. Optional.

regiments.description: The composition of the division. Sub-units are defined in common/units/*.txt files.

support.description: The support companies of the division. Sub-units are defined in common/units/*.txt files.

division_template.notes: The ''x'' and ''y'' attributes represent the rows and columns in the division designer and start from 0. No tooltip is shown.

drop_cosmetic_tag.name: drop_cosmetic_tag
drop_cosmetic_tag.description: Makes the current scope drop the current cosmetic tag they are using.

effect_tooltip.name: effect_tooltip
effect_tooltip.description: Displays the effects in the tooltip without executing them.

end_puppet.name: end_puppet
end_puppet.description: Removes the subject status between the target and the current scope.
end_puppet.notes: Must be used within the overlord's scope.

event_option_tooltip.name: event_option_tooltip
event_option_tooltip.description: Shows the tooltip usually received for hovering over an event option with the specified name.
event_option_tooltip.notes: ROOT and FROM scopes are swapped.

every_active_scientist.name: every_active_scientist
every_active_scientist.description:
Executes children effects on every active scientist (or "random_select_amount" of random character if specified) of the country in scope, that fulfills the "limit" trigger.title.

**Example:**
```paradox
`every_active_scientist = { … }`
```

every_allied_country.name: every_allied_country
every_allied_country.description:
Executes children effects on every Allied Country different from the one in scope (or `random_select_amount` of random country if specified) that fulfills the `limit` trigger.

**Example:**
```paradox
`every_allied_country = { … }`
```

every_army_leader.name: every_army_leader
every_army_leader.description:
Executes contained effects on every army leader that meets the limit and is recruited by the country this is contained in.

**Example:**
```paradox
`every_unit_leader = { … }`
```

every_character.name: every_character
every_character.description:
Executes contained effects on every character that meets the limit and is recruited by the country this is contained in.

**Example:**
```paradox
`every_character = { … }`
```

every_collection_element.name: every_collection_element

every_controlled_state.name: every_controlled_state
every_controlled_state.description:
Executes contained effects on every state that meets the limit and is controlled by the country this is contained in.

**Example:**
```paradox
`every_controlled_state = { … }`
```

every_core_state.name: every_core_state
every_core_state.description:
Executes contained effects on every state that meets the limit and is a core of the country this is contained in.

**Example:**
```paradox
`every_core_state = { … }`
```

every_country.name: every_country
every_country.description:
Executes contained effects on every country that meets the limit.

**Example:**
```paradox
`every_country = { … }`
```

every_country_division.name: every_country_division
every_country_division.description:
Executes contained effects on every division that meets the limit and is owned by the current country.

**Example:**
```paradox
`every_country_division = { … }`
```

every_country_with_original_tag.name: every_country_with_original_tag
every_country_with_original_tag.description:
Executes contained effects on every country that meets the limit and has the specified original tag.

**Example:**
```paradox
every_country_with_original_tag = {
    original_tag_to_check = TAG  #required
    …                  #effects to run
}
```

every_enemy_country.name: every_enemy_country
every_enemy_country.description:
Executes contained effects on every country that meets the limit and is at war with the country this is contained in.

**Example:**
```paradox
`every_enemy_country = { … }`
```

every_faction_member.name: every_faction_member
every_faction_member.description:
Executes children effects on every faction member of the country's faction in scope, if country does not have a faction it will only work on itself.

**Example:**
```paradox
`every_faction_member = { … }`
```

every_military_industrial_organization.name: every_military_industrial_organization
every_military_industrial_organization.description:
Executes contained effects on every MIO within the current country that meets the limit.

**Example:**
```paradox
`every_military_industrial_organization = { … }`
```

every_navy_leader.name: every_navy_leader
every_navy_leader.description:
Executes contained effects on every navy leader that meets the limit and is recruited by the country this is contained in.

**Example:**
```paradox
`every_navy_leader = { … }`
```

every_neighbor_country.name: every_neighbor_country
every_neighbor_country.description:
Executes contained effects on every country that meets the limit and borders the country this is contained in.

**Example:**
```paradox
`every_neighbor_country = { … }`
```

every_neighbor_state.name: every_neighbor_state
every_neighbor_state.description:
Executes contained effects on every state that meets the limit and neighbours the state this is contained in.

**Example:**
```paradox
`every_neighbor_state = { … }`
```

every_occupied_country.name: every_occupied_country
every_occupied_country.description:
Executes contained effects on every country that meets the limit and has any core states controlled by the country this is contained in.

**Example:**
```paradox
`every_occupied_country = { … }`
```

every_operative.name: every_operative
every_operative.description:
Executes contained effects on every operative that meets the limit and is recruited by the country this is contained in.

**Example:**
```paradox
`every_operative = { … }`
```

every_other_country.name: every_other_country
every_other_country.description:
Executes contained effects on every country that meets the limit and is not the same country as the one this is contained in.

**Example:**
```paradox
`every_other_country = { … }`
```

every_owned_state.name: every_owned_state
every_owned_state.description:
Executes contained effects on every state that meets the limit and is owned by the country this is contained in.

**Example:**
```paradox
`every_owned_state = { … }`
```

every_possible_country.name: every_possible_country
every_possible_country.description:
Executes children effects on every country that meets the limit, including those that do not exist.

**Example:**
```paradox
`every_possible_country = { ... }`
```

every_purchase_contract.name: every_purchase_contract
every_purchase_contract.description:
Executes contained effects on every purchase contract within the current country that meets the limit.

**Example:**
```paradox
`every_purchase_contract = { … }`
```

every_scientist.name: every_scientist
every_scientist.description:
Executes children effects on every scientist (or "random_select_amount" of random character if specified) of the country in scope, that fulfills the "limit" trigger.

**Example:**
```paradox
`every_scientist = { … }`
```

every_state.name: every_state
every_state.description:
Executes contained effects on every state that meets the limit.

**Example:**
```paradox
`every_state = { … }`
```

every_state_division.name: every_state_division
every_state_division.description:
Executes contained effects on every division that meets the limit and is located within the current state.

**Example:**
```paradox
`every_state_division = { … }`
```

every_subject_country.name: every_subject_country
every_subject_country.description:
Executes contained effects on every country that meets the limit and is a subject of the country this is contained in.

**Example:**
```paradox
`every_subject_country = { … }`
```

every_unit_leader.name: every_unit_leader
every_unit_leader.description:
Executes contained effects on every unit leader (corps commanders, field marshals, admirals) that meets the limit and is recruited by the country this is contained in.

**Example:**
```paradox
`every_unit_leader = { … }`
```

execute_operation_coordinated_strike.name: execute_operation_coordinated_strike
execute_operation_coordinated_strike.description: All prepared Port Strike and Strategic Bombing in the target region will execute multiple times without air defence being able to intercept them.

amount.description: How many times the operation will get executed within the days set in the operation.

execute_operation_coordinated_strike.notes: Can only be used within operations.

find_highest_in_array.name: find_highest_in_array
find_highest_in_array.description: Finds the largest value in the array and assigns its value and index to a temporary variable.

value.description: The temporary variable where the largest value will get stored.

index.description: The temporary variable where the index of the largest value will get stored.

find_highest_in_array.notes: Either value or index are optional to specify.

find_lowest_in_array.name: find_lowest_in_array
find_lowest_in_array.description: Finds the smallest value in the array and assigns its value and index to a temporary variable.

value.description: The temporary variable where the smallest value will get stored.

index.description: The temporary variable where the index of the smallest value will get stored.

find_lowest_in_array.notes: Either value or index are optional to specify.

force_disable_resistance.name: force_disable_resistance
force_disable_resistance.description: Disables resistance for the scoped state when the occupier is the specified country.

clear.description: If set to yes, will clear resistance.

occupier.description: Resistance will be disabled if the occupier is the specified scope.

occupied.description: Resistance will be disabled if the occupied country is the specified scope.

force_enable_resistance.name: force_enable_resistance
force_enable_resistance.description: Enables resistance for the scoped state when the occupier is the specified country.
force_enable_resistance.notes: Does not start resistance by itself, only removes the checks forcefully disabling it. Use with [[#start_resistance|start_resistance]] in order to immediately start resistance.

force_operative_leader_into_hiding.name: force_operative_leader_into_hiding
force_operative_leader_into_hiding.description: Forces the current operative into hiding.

force_update_dynamic_modifier.name: force_update_dynamic_modifier
force_update_dynamic_modifier.description: Forces an update to the effects given by variables within dynamic modifiers.
force_update_dynamic_modifier.notes: An update is done daily by default; this can be used if the applied values need to be changed urgently, such as if modifiers are checked or used later in the effect block.

force_update_map_mode.name: force_update_map_mode
force_update_map_mode.description: Forcefully refreshes the specified mapmode for the player, rather than waiting for a daily update.

limit.description: Triggers required for the map mode to refresh. Optional.

mapmode.description: The ID of the custom map mode.

force_update_map_mode.notes: Map modes are defined in common/map_modes/*.txt

captured_by.description: The country that captured the operative.

free_random_operative.name: free_random_operative
free_random_operative.description: Frees one random captured operative or all of them.

captured_by.description: The country that captured the operative.

all.description: Whether to free all operatives or not (Defaults to no).

gain_xp.name: gain_xp
gain_xp.description: Adds experience to the current unit leader, promoting to the next skill level if applicable.

generate_character.name: generate_character
generate_character.description: Generates a character for current country.

token_base.description: Mandatory, acts as the character token.

name.description: The name used for the character. Generates a random name if not set.

generate_character.notes: If used to create an advisor, the idea token of the advisor role will be the token_base and idea_token (defaulting to the slot if the idea token is not set) concatenated, with an underscore as a separator. In the provided example, the idea token will be army_chief_defensive_1_GER_character_token_air_chief; if idea_token wasn't present, it'd be army_chief_defensive_1_air_chief.

generate_scientist_character.name: generate_scientist_character
generate_scientist_character.description: Generate a new character with a scientist role and recruit it in the country in scope.

portrait_tag_override.description: Optional, accepts variable and keyword, only relevant if using random portrait, by default use country in scope.

skills.description: Optional array, same format as in scientist role in character DB, by default all skills are at 1.

get_highest_scored_country_temp.name: get_highest_scored_country_temp
get_highest_scored_country_temp.description: Calculates the highest scored country that is defined in a country scorer and sets it to a variable.

scorer.description: Id that is used in country scorer.

get_sorted_scored_countries_temp.name: get_sorted_scored_countries_temp
get_sorted_scored_countries_temp.description: Calculates & sorts all countries in a country scorer and stores them and their scores in temp arrays.

scorer.description: Id that is used in country scorer.

array.description: A name to store sorted countries as a temp array (default to sorted_country_list)

scores.description: Corresponding score temp array for countries stored in array (default to country_list_scores)

get_supply_vehicles.name: get_supply_vehicles
get_supply_vehicles.description: Sets a variable to the number of supply vehicles in stockpile or that are needed.

type.description: Can be truck or train.

need.description: Default no. If yes, gets the number of needed vehicles.

get_supply_vehicles_temp.name: get_supply_vehicles_temp
get_supply_vehicles_temp.description: Sets a temp variable to the number of supply vehicles in stockpile or that are needed.

type.description: Can be truck or train.

need.description: Default no. If yes, gets the number of needed vehicles.

give_guarantee.name: give_guarantee
give_guarantee.description: The current scope guarantees the target country.
give_guarantee.notes: [[#diplomatic_relation|diplomatic_relation]] effect can be used to remove it.

give_market_access.name: give_market_access
give_market_access.description: Opens market access between the two countries.

give_military_access.name: give_military_access
give_military_access.description: The current scope grants military access to the target country.
give_military_access.notes: [[#diplomatic_relation|diplomatic_relation]] effect can be used to remove it.

give_resource_rights.name: give_resource_rights
give_resource_rights.description: Gives all the resources of a state to the target country

receiver.description: The country that would get the resource rights.

state.description: The state where the resource rights are located.

resources.description: The resources to which give resource rights to. Optional, defaults to all.

give_resource_rights.notes: The resource rights will only be provided as long as the current country controls the state with resource rights.

global_every_army_leader.name: global_every_army_leader
global_every_army_leader.description:
Executes contained effects on every army leader that meets the limit. Preferable to use every_army_leader unless necessary to use global_every_army_leader.

**Example:**
```paradox
`global_every_army_leader = { … }`
```

goto_province.name: goto_province
goto_province.description: Moves the camera position over the specified province.

goto_state.name: goto_state
goto_state.description: Moves the camera position over the specified state.

harm_operative_leader.name: harm_operative_leader
harm_operative_leader.notes: The value is subject to modifiers.

hold_election.name: hold_election
hold_election.description: Executes the events in the '''on_new_term_election''' on action for the current scope.

inherit_technology.name: inherit_technology
inherit_technology.description: Makes the current country's researched technologies be copied from the specified country.
inherit_technology.notes: Useful when making a country independent.

injure_scientist_for_days.name: injure_scientist_for_days
injure_scientist_for_days.description: Injure a scientist for x amount of days to a scientist character in scope.

kill_country_leader.name: kill_country_leader
kill_country_leader.description: Kills the country leader for the current scope.

kill_ideology_leader.name: kill_ideology_leader
kill_ideology_leader.description: Kills the country leader of the designated ideology for the current scope.

killed_by.description: The country that'll kill the operative.

launch_nuke.name: launch_nuke
launch_nuke.description: Nukes the specified province or a province in the needed state. If a state is set rather than the specific province, first prioritises the country set in controller, then prioritises the countries at war with the current scope, and then countries that are neutral.

controller.description: Prioritises provinces controlled by this country.

use_nuke.description: Whether a nuke should be deducted from the country's stockpile. Defaults to false.

nuke_type.description: type of nuke to use (e.g. nuclear_bomb, thermonuclear_bomb etc.)

launch_nuke.notes: If set to use a nuke, then requires at least one nuclear bomb in the stockpile.

leave_faction.name: leave_faction
leave_faction.description: Removes the current scope from the faction they are part of.

load_focus_tree.name: load_focus_tree
load_focus_tree.description: Loads a new focus tree for the current scope, retaining any shared focuses if set.

tree.description: The national focus tree to load.

keep_completed.description: Whether focuses shared between the old and new trees should stay completed. Defaults to false.

copy_completed_from.description: Copy completed focus from an existing country.

load_focus_tree.notes: Focuses that aren't present in the newly-loaded tree will not be kept as completed for [[Triggers#has_completed_focus|has_completed_focus]] checks or when loading the old tree back.

load_oob.name: load_oob
load_oob.description: Loads the specified order of battle for the current scope, applying the effects within. The filename with the .txt extension omitted is used as the effect's target.
load_oob.notes: Orders of battle are stored within history/units/*.txt. Primarily used to spawn divisions at specified locations.

log.name: log
log.description: Displays a string in the [[Modding|user directory's]] logs/game.log file when executed, as well as showing up in the console if it is open when the logging effect was executed.

mark_focus_tree_layout_dirty.name: mark_focus_tree_layout_dirty
mark_focus_tree_layout_dirty.description: Refreshes the focus tree for the specified country, restarting the checks in allow_branch and position offsets for focuses.
mark_focus_tree_layout_dirty.notes:
If put within a focus' completion reward, the focus will not be marked as complete at the time the effect is executed, leading to has_completed_focus checks specifying that focus in particular to be marked as false.

This can be bypassed by putting an effect within a hidden event fired immediately within the focus or by reloading the same focus tree with load_focus_tree set to keep completed focuses, marking the focus as complete, before using the effect.

mark_technology_tree_layout_dirty.name: mark_technology_tree_layout_dirty
mark_technology_tree_layout_dirty.description: Forces the refresh of the hidden technologies for the scoped country.

modify_building_resources.name: modify_building_resources
modify_building_resources.description: Modifies the resource output of the specified building for the current scope.

amount.description: The amount of resource to add.

modify_character_flag.name: modify_character_flag
modify_character_flag.description: Adds an integer value to a flag.

value.description: The value to add to the flag. Defaults to 0.

days.description: The amount of days that the flag should last for before being cleared. Optional, defaults to permanent.

modify_character_flag.notes: The flag must be already set.

modify_country_flag.name: modify_country_flag
modify_country_flag.description: Adds an integer value to a flag.

value.description: The value to add to the flag. Defaults to 0.

days.description: The amount of days that the flag should last for before being cleared. Optional, defaults to permanent.

modify_country_flag.notes: The flag must be already set.

modify_global_flag.name: modify_global_flag
modify_global_flag.description: Adds an integer value to a flag.

value.description: The value to add to the flag. Defaults to 0.

days.description: The amount of days that the flag should last for before being cleared. Optional, defaults to permanent.

modify_global_flag.notes: The flag must be already set.

modify_mio_flag.name: modify_mio_flag
modify_mio_flag.description: Adds an integer value to a flag.

value.description: The value to add to the flag. Defaults to 0.

days.description: The amount of days that the flag should last for before being cleared. Optional, defaults to permanent.

modify_mio_flag.notes: The flag must be already set.

modify_project_flag.name: modify_project_flag
modify_project_flag.description: Adds an integer value to a flag.

value.description: The value to add to the flag. Defaults to 0.

days.description: The amount of days that the flag should last for before being cleared. Optional, defaults to permanent.

modify_project_flag.notes: The flag must be already set.

modify_state_flag.name: modify_state_flag
modify_state_flag.description: Adds an integer value to a flag.

value.description: The value to add to the flag. Defaults to 0.

days.description: The amount of days that the flag should last for before being cleared. Optional, defaults to permanent.

modify_state_flag.notes: The flag must be already set.

modify_tech_sharing_bonus.name: modify_tech_sharing_bonus
modify_tech_sharing_bonus.description: Modifies the specified technology sharing group.
modify_tech_sharing_bonus.notes: Technology sharing groups are found in Hearts of Iron IV\common\technology_sharing\*.txt

modify_timed_idea.name: modify_timed_idea
modify_timed_idea.description: Extends or shortens the duration of the timed idea by the specified amount.

days.description: The number of days to modify the idea by.

months.description: The number of months to modify the idea by. A month is equal to 30 days.

years.description: The number of years to modify the idea by. A year is equal to 365 days.

modify_timed_idea.notes: Positives add to the time, negatives shorten it. Either one of days, months, or years is mandatory. The tooltip will use the exact same phrasing in years/months/days as used in the attributes.

modify_unit_leader_flag.name: modify_unit_leader_flag
modify_unit_leader_flag.description: Adds an integer value to a flag.

value.description: The value to add to the flag. Defaults to 0.

days.description: The amount of days that the flag should last for before being cleared. Optional, defaults to permanent.

modify_unit_leader_flag.notes: The flag must be already set. Deprecated. Use [[#modify_character_flag|modify_character_flag]] instead.

modulo_variable.name: modulo_variable
modulo_variable.description:
Makes the variable become the remainder of Euclidean division of the variable by the specified value.

**Example:**
```paradox
modulo_variable = {
    var = my_variable
    value = 50
    tooltip = get_modulo_of_var_by_50_tt
}
```

```paradox
modulo_temp_variable = { temp_var = num_controlled_states }
```

multiply_variable.name: multiply_variable
multiply_variable.description:
Multiplies a variable's value by the specified amount.

**Example:**
```paradox
multiply_variable = {
    var = my_variable
    value = 100
    tooltip = multiply_var_by_100_tt
}
```

```paradox
multiply_temp_variable = { temp_var = num_owned_states }
```

navy_experience.name: navy_experience
navy_experience.description: Adds the specified amount of navy experience to the current scope.

news_event.name: news_event
news_event.description: Fires the specified news event for the current country.

days.description: Fires the event in the specified number of days. Optional.

hours.description: Fires the event in the specified number of hours. Optional.

random_hours.description: Adds a random number (between ''0'' and ''random_hours'', inclusive) of hours to the scheduled fire time. Optional.

random_days.description: Adds a random number (between ''0'' and ''random_days'', inclusive) of days to the scheduled fire time. Optional.

examples:
news_event = {
 id = my_event.1
 days = 10
 random_hours = 12
 random_days = 10
}

news_event = my_event.1
news_event.notes:
The news event uses a different interface to the country event.

Where triggers do not need to be repeatedly checked random can be a performance light alternative to mean_time_to_happen for scheduling events. Shortened variant exists if the event's ID is used instead of arguments.

operative_leader_event.name: operative_leader_event
operative_leader_event.description: Fires the specified event for the operative.

days.description: Fires the event in the specified number of days. Optional.
