transfer_state.description: Makes the current scope the owner and controller of the specified state.

transfer_state_to.name: transfer_state_to
transfer_state_to.description: Sets owner and controller of the state to the given country

transfer_units_fraction.name: transfer_units_fraction
transfer_units_fraction.description: Transfers a fraction of the military to a target, including units (either type: land, navy, or air), equipment, and unit leaders.

target.description: The country which should receive the units from the current scope.

size.description: The size of the breakaway country and the fraction of the original stockpile and military units it will receive by default. Optional, defaults to 0.5.

army_ratio.description: The size of the land army that the breakaway country gets. Optional, defaults to being the same as size.

navy_ratio.description: The size of the naval forces that the breakaway country gets. Optional, defaults to being the same as size.

air_ratio.description: The size of the airforce that the breakaway country gets. Optional, defaults to being the same as size.

keep_unit_leaders.description: List of unit leaders to be kept by their legacy_id. Optional.

keep_unit_leaders_trigger.description: Trigger block checked for every unit leader that forces them to be kept if they meet the triggers. The default scope is the unit leader, ROOT is the country receiving the unit leader, while FROM is the original owner of the unit leader. Optional.

turn_operative.name: turn_operative
turn_operative.description: Turns the current operative against their own country, transferring them to the specified country.

turned_by.description: The country to which the operative defects.

turn_operative.notes: This counts as the operative dying and will trigger the corresponding [[On action]]. Logs an error if used against your own operative.

uncomplete_national_focus.name: uncomplete_national_focus
uncomplete_national_focus.description:
Removes a focus from list of completed focus, and potentially all focuses requiring it as a prerequisite.
If the focus has one, the 'on_uncomplete' effect will be executed on each uncompleted focus.

unit_leader_event.name: unit_leader_event
unit_leader_event.description: Fires the specified event for the owner of the current unit leader.

days.description: Fires the event in the specified number of days. Optional.

hours.description: Fires the event in the specified number of hours. Optional.

random.description: Adds a random number (between ''0'' and ''random'', inclusive) of hours to the scheduled fire time. Optional.

random_days.description: Adds a random number (between ''0'' and ''random_days'', inclusive) of days to the scheduled fire time. Optional.

unit_leader_event.notes:
Uses a special interface displaying the current unit leader portrait.
Where triggers do not need to be repeatedly checked random can be a performance light alternative to mean_time_to_happen for scheduling events.

unlock_decision_category_tooltip.name: unlock_decision_category_tooltip
unlock_decision_category_tooltip.description: Displays a special tooltip for the specified decision category in the effect tooltip.
unlock_decision_category_tooltip.notes: Decision categories are found in common/decisions/catergories/*.txt

unlock_decision_tooltip.name: unlock_decision_tooltip
unlock_decision_tooltip.description: Displays a special tooltip for the specified decision in the effect tooltip.

unlock_military_industrial_organization_.name: unlock_military_industrial_organization_tooltip
unlock_military_industrial_organization_.description: Display a tooltip saying the MIO is made available (aka unlocked).

unlock_mio_policy_tooltip.name: unlock_mio_policy_tooltip
unlock_mio_policy_tooltip.description: Displays a tooltip that says that the policy is made available.

show_modifiers.description: Whether the trait's modifiers should be shown in the tooltip. Defaults to true.

unlock_mio_policy_tooltip.notes: Doesn't change the availability of the policy directly.

unlock_mio_trait_tooltip.name: unlock_mio_trait_tooltip
unlock_mio_trait_tooltip.description: Displays a tooltip that says that the trait is made available.

show_modifiers.description: Whether the trait's modifiers should be shown in the tooltip. Defaults to true.

unlock_mio_trait_tooltip.notes: Doesn't change the availability of the trait directly.

unlock_national_focus.name: unlock_national_focus
unlock_national_focus.description: Bypasses the specified focus for the current scope (marks as complete without firing complete_effect of the focus).

unlock_tactic.name: unlock_tactic
unlock_tactic.description: Unlocks the specified combat tactic for the country.

upgrade_intelligence_agency.name: upgrade_intelligence_agency
upgrade_intelligence_agency.notes: Upgrades can be found in common/intelligence_agency_upgrades

white_peace.name: white_peace
white_peace.description: Makes the current scope white peace the specified scope.

message.description: The reason for peace showing up in the pop-up.

controller.name: controller

capital_scope.name: capital_scope
capital_scope.description:
The state where the capital of the current country is located in. Subject to the 'invalid event target' error in rare cases.

**Example:**
```paradox
`capital_scope = { … }`
```

every_unit.name: every_unit
every_unit.description: Execute effects on every unit that meets the limit.

var_list.description: The variables to print. Defaults to all variables.

file.description: The file path to log to. Defaults to "variable_dump". Does not include the

text.description: Text to prepend. Defaults to "No Header".

append.description: Whether to append to the file instead of overwrite. Defaults to

focus.name: focus
focus.description: A national focus inside common/national_focus/*.txt focus_tree blocks. Grants its completion_reward after being picked and worked on for cost days-worth of political power.

id.description: Unique identifier of the focus. Prefixed with the country tag by convention to avoid clashes between trees.

icon.description: The sprite used as the focus icon (GFX_ name from interface/*.gfx).

x.description: Horizontal grid position. One unit is 96 pixels by default; larger values move the focus right. Relative to relative_position_id when that is set, otherwise to the top-left of the tree.

y.description: Vertical grid position. One unit is 130 pixels by default; larger values move the focus down. Relative to relative_position_id when that is set, otherwise to the top-left of the tree.

relative_position_id.description: Positions this focus relative to another focus in the same tree: x and y are added to that focus' resolved position (which may itself be relative). Preferred over absolute positions for branches — moving one focus moves its whole subtree. Must not recurse (self/cycle) or point outside this focus tree: the engine behaves unstably, potentially crashing.

offset.description: Conditional position shift: x and y are added to the focus' position when the trigger = { ... } sub-block is true for the country at tree-load time (refreshed mid-session by mark_focus_tree_layout_dirty). Repeatable — typically one offset per importing tree with trigger = { has_focus_tree = ... }. Prefer relative_position_id for branch layout; use offset only on the top focus of a branch that needs moving.

cost.description: Focus completion cost in political power. 1 unit equals 7 days; the vanilla-standard value is 10 (= 70 days). Defaults to 10 if unset.

available_if_capitulated.description: Allows the focus to be selected and completed while the country has capitulated. Defaults to no — a capitulated country can see the focus but cannot pick it. Vanilla typically sets this on branch-continuation focuses so a war loss cannot lock off the rest of the tree.

available.description: AND trigger block gating whether the focus can be picked, on top of prerequisites. Scoped to the country doing the focus; scope out to states or other countries for ownership, strength, or diplomatic conditions.

allow_branch.description: Trigger block deciding whether the focus (and its branch) is visible. Checked only when the focus tree is first loaded — refresh mid-session with mark_focus_tree_layout_dirty. A focus with its own allow_branch checks only itself, ignoring disallowed parents; without one, a disallowed parent disallows the child. Usually paired with offset blocks to swap whole branches per tree.

prerequisite.description: Focus(es) that must be completed first. Multiple focus = X lines inside one prerequisite block are ORs; multiple prerequisite blocks are ANDs.

mutually_exclusive.description: A focus that can never be taken if this one is completed (and vice versa). Renders the red mutual-exclusion arrow in the tree view.

bypass.description: AND trigger block for bypassing: while true the focus auto-completes without granting completion_reward. Same scoping as available. Combine with bypass_if_unavailable = yes to auto-bypass whenever available fails, or enable_automatic_bypass = no to forbid auto-bypass.

bypass_effect.description: Effects executed instead of completion_reward when the focus is bypassed (e.g. add_popularity = { ideology = fascism popularity = 0.05 }).

completion_reward.description: Effects executed when the focus completes.

ai_will_do.description: MTTH weight block for AI focus picking when no ai_national_focuses plan entry fires (factor/base plus modifier = { factor/add + triggers }). Each candidate rolls 0..value — times FOCUS_TREE_CONTINUE_FACTOR right after a prerequisite finished, times focus_factors from the active AI plan — highest roll wins; all-zero means the AI idles or takes continuous focuses.

search_filters.description: Bare FOCUS_FILTER_* identifiers shown in the focus-tree search menu. A custom filter needs a GFX_<filter-name> sprite and loc key with the exact filter name, or it will not render.

focus.notes: Positioning: x/y are grid units (96px / 130px by default), relative to relative_position_id when set. The engine behaves unstably on relative_position_id recursion (self-reference or cycles can crash the game); the referenced focus must be in the same tree. available_if_capitulated defaults to no.

shared_focus.name: shared_focus
shared_focus.description: Defines a focus outside any focus_tree block, imported into every tree listed via shared_focus = <id>. Same sub-structure as focus; positioning is per-tree via offset = { ... } blocks with trigger = { has_focus_tree = ... }.

id.description: Unique identifier of the focus. Prefixed with the country tag by convention to avoid clashes between trees.

icon.description: The sprite used as the focus icon (GFX_ name from interface/*.gfx).

x.description: Horizontal grid position. One unit is 96 pixels by default; larger values move the focus right. Relative to relative_position_id when that is set, otherwise to the top-left of the tree.

y.description: Vertical grid position. One unit is 130 pixels by default; larger values move the focus down. Relative to relative_position_id when that is set, otherwise to the top-left of the tree.

relative_position_id.description: Positions this focus relative to another focus in the same tree: x and y are added to that focus' resolved position (which may itself be relative). Preferred over absolute positions for branches — moving one focus moves its whole subtree. Must not recurse (self/cycle) or point outside this focus tree: the engine behaves unstably, potentially crashing.

offset.description: Conditional position shift: x and y are added to the focus' position when the trigger = { ... } sub-block is true for the country at tree-load time (refreshed mid-session by mark_focus_tree_layout_dirty). Repeatable — typically one offset per importing tree with trigger = { has_focus_tree = ... }. Prefer relative_position_id for branch layout; use offset only on the top focus of a branch that needs moving.

capital.name: capital
capital.description: Defines the capital state for the country in history/countries. The province with the most victory points within that state will be used as the capital. In case of overlap, the lowest province ID among the possible choices is chosen. This must be a state ID, not a province ID.
capital.notes: Only valid in history/countries files (and date blocks within them). History files are executed as an effect block for the country. If not specified, the engine picks a fallback capital.

oob.name: oob
oob.description: Loads a land order of battle (OOB) for the country in history, linking to a file in history/units/*.txt (without the .txt extension). The filename is arbitrary as long as it matches the file. This is the traditional history argument for land divisions and cannot be used inside if statements; use set_oob instead for conditional loading.
oob.notes: History argument, not a generic effect. For conditional loading (e.g. DLC-gated OOBs) use set_oob / set_naval_oob / set_air_oob inside if blocks. Naval and air OOBs use set_naval_oob / set_air_oob. Countries with no OOB will have broken buildings. OOB files are defined in history/units/. Replaces any previously defined OOB of the same type.

num_units_defensive_combats_on.description: number of units that are defensively fighting on a terrain, terrain type is defined as target. example: num_units_defensive_combats_on@plains

num_units_in_state.name: num_units_in_state
num_units_in_state.description: number of units controlled by leader in state, state is in target. example num_units_in_state@123

num_units_offensive_combats.name: num_units_offensive_combats
num_units_offensive_combats.description: number of units in offensive combats

num_units_offensive_combats_against.name: num_units_offensive_combats_against
num_units_offensive_combats_against.description: number of units that are offensively fighting against a terrain, terrain type is defined as target. example: num_units_offensive_combats_against@plains

num_units_on_climate.name: num_units_on_climate
num_units_on_climate.description: number of units that are on an acclimatization required location, acclimatization type is defined in target. example num_units_on_climate@hot_climate

num_units_with_type.name: num_units_with_type
num_units_with_type.description: number of units with dominant type controlled by leader, dominant type is defined in target. example: num_units_with_type@light_armor

number_of_currently_assigned_tasks.name: number_of_currently_assigned_tasks
number_of_currently_assigned_tasks.description: Number of tasks the military industrial organization is currently assigned to

number_of_unlocked_traits.name: number_of_unlocked_traits
number_of_unlocked_traits.description: Number of unlocked traits of the military industrial organization.

number_of_unused_trait_points.name: number_of_unused_trait_points
number_of_unused_trait_points.description: Number of unused trait points of the military industrial organization

operation_country.name: operation_country
operation_country.description: the country location the operative is assigned. 0 if it is not assigned to a country

operation_state.name: operation_state
operation_state.description: the state location the operative is assigned. 0 if it is not assigned to a state

operation_type.name: operation_type
operation_type.description: returns the operation token the operative is assigned

operations.name: operations
operations.description: array of objects in operations database

operative_captor.name: operative_captor
operative_captor.description: returns the country tag that captured the operative

opinion.name: opinion
opinion.description: opinion of a country targeted on another one. example GER.opinion@ENG

original_research_slots.name: original_research_slots
original_research_slots.description: check number of research slots at start of game

original_tag.name: original_tag
original_tag.description: returns the original tag of a country

own_capture_chance_factor.name: own_capture_chance_factor
own_capture_chance_factor.description: The chance this operative has to be captured, taking into account the country it is operating for and the country it is operating against.

own_forced_into_hiding_time_factor.name: own_forced_into_hiding_time_factor
own_forced_into_hiding_time_factor.description: The time factor applied to the status "forced into hiding". Takes into account the country it is operating for and the country it is operating against.

own_harmed_time_factor.name: own_harmed_time_factor
own_harmed_time_factor.description: The time factor applied to the status "harmed". Takes int accountthe country it is operating for and the country it is operating against.

party_popularity.name: party_popularity
party_popularity.description: popularity of targeted party [0.00, 1.00]. example party_popularity@democratic. May also target ruling_party. This also supports country variables, so you can party_popularity@my_var_name for variables that store ideologies

party_popularity_100.name: party_popularity_100
party_popularity_100.description: popularity of targeted party [0.00, 100.00]. example party_popularity_100@democratic. May also target ruling_party. This also supports country variables, so you can party_popularity_100@my_var_name for variables that store ideologies

pc_current_score.name: pc_current_score
pc_current_score.description: Checks country's total peace conference score. Only usable if the country is on the winning side.

pc_total_score.name: pc_total_score
pc_total_score.description: Checks country's total peace conference score. Only usable if the country is on the winning side.

planning_skill_level.name: planning_skill_level
planning_skill_level.description: Compares planning skill level of a unit leader.

political_advisor.name: political_advisor
political_advisor.description: returns an array with the currently hired political advisors of the country

political_power_daily.name: political_power_daily
political_power_daily.description: Checks if daily political power increase is more or less that specified value

political_power_growth.name: political_power_growth
political_power_growth.description: Check the value of political power daily growth.Exacmple: political_power_growth > 0

potential_and_current_enemies.name: potential_and_current_enemies
potential_and_current_enemies.description: array of potential and actual enemies

power_balance_daily.name: power_balance_daily
power_balance_daily.description: current total power balance daily change

power_balance_daily_change.name: power_balance_daily_change
power_balance_daily_change.description: compares current total daily change of a power balance

power_balance_weekly.name: power_balance_weekly
power_balance_weekly.description: current total power balance weekly change

power_balance_weekly_change.name: power_balance_weekly_change
power_balance_weekly_change.description: compares current total weekly change of a power balance

province_controllers.name: province_controllers
province_controllers.description: get array of all province controllers. Example: province_controllers^4135

research_bonus.name: research_bonus
research_bonus.description: Research bonus of the military industrial organization when assigned to a research slot

researched_techs.name: researched_techs
researched_techs.description: returns the array of researched technologies

resistance.name: resistance
resistance.description: Compares the current resistance level of a state to a value. Example: resistance > 50

resistance_speed.name: resistance_speed
resistance_speed.description: Compares the current resistance speed of a state to a value. Example: resistance_speed > 50

resistance_target.name: resistance_target
resistance_target.description: Compares the target resistance level of a state to a value. Example: resistance_target > 50

resource.name: resource
resource.description: number of surplus resources in country, resource type is defined in target resource@steel

resource_consumed.name: resource_consumed
resource_consumed.description: number of resources consumed by country, resource type is defined in target resource_consumed@steel

resource_exported.name: resource_exported
resource_exported.description: number of resources exported by country, resource type is defined in target resource_exported@steel

resource_imported.name: resource_imported
resource_imported.description: number of resources imported by country, resource type is defined in target resource_imported@steel

resource_produced.name: resource_produced
resource_produced.description: number of resources produced by country, resource type is defined in target. example resource_produced@steel

scientist.name: scientist
scientist.description: The scientist that researches the project

size.name: size
size.description: Size of the military industrial organization

state_population.name: state_population
state_population.description: check the population in the state

state_population_k.name: state_population_k
state_population_k.description: check the population in the state in thousands (use to avoid variable overflows)

sum_unit_terrain_modifier.name: sum_unit_terrain_modifier
sum_unit_terrain_modifier.description: sum of terrain modifiers of each army's location, terrain type is defined in target. example: sum_unit_terrain_modifier@sickness_chance

surrender_progress.name: surrender_progress
surrender_progress.description: check if a country is close to surrendering

technology.name: technology
technology.description: array of objects in technology database

theorist.name: theorist
theorist.description: returns the currently hired theorist of the country

threat.name: threat
threat.description: check the global threat value (world tension). 0-1 value

unit_modifier.name: unit_modifier
unit_modifier.description: value of a modifier stored in unit modifier, modifier token is defined in target. example unit_modifier@army_attack_factor

unit_ratio_ready_for_plan.name: unit_ratio_ready_for_plan
unit_ratio_ready_for_plan.description: ratio of units that are ready for plan
